title: Create new EU/EEA cookie banner component
body: **Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.** GNL are changing how the cookie banner works in the EU/EEA - but not in the UK. **Describe the solution you'd like** Create a component that meets the requirements of GNL: * The banner is an overlay for the entire page. It is not possible for the user to interact with the page without accepting the cookies * The banner will display the new wording (set in service config in Simorgh) * Clicking the agree button will set the ckns_explicit cookie = `2` and the ckns_policy cookie = `111` **Describe alternatives you've considered** N/A **Testing notes** [Tester to complete] Dev insight: Will Cypress tests be required or are unit tests sufficient? Will there be any potential regression? etc - [ ] This feature is expected to need manual testing. **Additional context** Add any other context or screenshots about the feature request here.
author: Participant 1
scope: Current retrievable issue body and issue comments; not the original study's historical snapshot. Linked pages and attachments are not fetched.
